children: Calix, Inc. (

) today announced that VA SkyWire is rapidly expanding their multi-dwelling unit (MDU) footprint with SmartMDU™ on the Calix One™ platform. By streamlining equipment deployment, administration, and technical support for secure, property-wide managed Wi-Fi, VA SkyWire achieved a 40 percent year-over-year increase in return on investment across their MDU business. SmartMDU gives VA SkyWire a purpose-built solution on a unified platform to efficiently enter new markets while delivering personalized Wi-Fi experiences for residents and property managers alike.

For multifamily property owners, delivering a seamless move-in experience is increasingly important, with 32 percent of MDU residents expecting Wi-Fi to be connected from day one. Against that backdrop, VA SkyWire has achieved a customer experience quality rating of more than 90 percent, based on an extensive analysis of resident support interactions from QueSee AI—a Calix partner that uses AI to proactively assess customer satisfaction and drive actionable operational insights. The rating reflects VA SkyWire’s continued investment in frontline technical training and resident support, along with their goal of lightning-fast service activation.
As VA SkyWire continues to expand in a competitive MDU market, SmartMDU enables them to easily scale connectivity across greenfield and brownfield properties on Calix One. This includes:
Scaling support without scaling complexity.

VA SkyWire gains greater network visibility down to individual units and connected devices at every property, enabling support teams to quickly identify issues, troubleshoot remotely, and efficiently serve more residents.
Simplifying property-wide operations on one platform.

SmartMDU helps eliminate fragmented hardware, vendors, and manual workflows for Wi-Fi by streamlining deployment and management across residential units, leasing offices, IoT devices, and common areas.
Accelerating service activation throughout the resident lifecycle.

With a service-left-in-place approach, VA SkyWire can install equipment once and enable residents with self-service activation options, such as QR codes or captive portal SSIDs, based on property preference.

An early adopter of SmartMDU, VA SkyWire has worked closely with Calix Success™ to help address the unique operational requirements of a service provider focused exclusively on MDUs, with a significant opportunity to continue expanding the managed service across their broader Calix footprint.
Scott Coonfield, president and chief executive officer at VA SkyWire, said:

“Getting residents online should be simple. ‘On in 60 seconds’ is the goal: They should be able to move in, connect to Wi-Fi, and get on with their day without having to call us. SmartMDU helps us deliver that simplicity on one platform and gives our teams the tools to efficiently support growth without compromising the experiences that differentiate our business.”
Michael Weening, president and chief executive officer at Calix, said:

“We continue to see service providers move quickly to tap the massive market opportunity MDU represents. That is why we purpose-built SmartMDU to bring entire properties onto one platform, and why we continue to innovate alongside customers like Scott Coonfield and the VA SkyWire team. For providers, that means simpler operations, better resident experiences, and the ability to scale without making the business more complex. We are grateful for VA SkyWire’s partnership and will continue to enable them with everything they need to move faster, grow their business, and win.”
Learn how Calix SmartMDU helps service providers grow and differentiate in the MDU market.
